title: Shared runtime protocol
responsibility: Defines request, response and runtime interfaces and constructs consistent transport failures.

inputs.name: runtimeFailure.code
inputs.description: Failure code to place in the returned RuntimeFailure. The function returns it unchanged and does not restrict it to TransportFailure.

inputs.name: runtimeFailure.message
inputs.description: Human-readable failure message to place in the returned RuntimeFailure. The function returns it unchanged without formatting or validation.

inputs.name: runtimeTimeout.timeoutMs
inputs.description: Timeout duration in milliseconds interpolated into the runtime-timeout message. This function constructs a failure response but does not enforce the timeout.

outputs.name: defaultRuntimeTimeoutMs
outputs.description: The exported default runtime timeout value is 30,000 milliseconds. This module declares and re-exports it but does not apply it to calls.

outputs.name: runtimeFailure
outputs.description: A failure RuntimeResponse containing ok false and a nested error with the supplied code and message. The strings are copied unchanged and are not validated.

outputs.name: runtimeTimeout
outputs.description: A failure RuntimeResponse with code runtime-timeout and message no response within <timeoutMs> ms. This function constructs the response but does not enforce a deadline.
